{{Quote|You musta been eatin' your space-carrots...never could stand 'em, myself!|Jaxxon|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Carrots''', also known as '''space-carrots''', were a favorite food of [[Rabbit/Legends|rabbits]]. Eating space carrots was said to improve eyesight. Thus, many people incorrectly assumed that the rabbit-like [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] were sharp-eyed space-carrot eaters. In truth, Lepi were omnivores with a preference for meat, and their sharp vision was due to their large eyes. 

The Lepi smuggler [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] could not stand space-carrots.

==Behind the scenes==
The joke is a reference to the myth that carrots improve vision. This was started as a rumor by the British Air Force during World War II as a cover for the advantage that the, then new and secret, technology Radar gave pilots. In fact, carrots are a good source of beta-carotene, which the body coverts to vitamin A. This does support eye health, however noticeable improvement in eyesight is only present in those with vitamin A deficiency.
